full_prompt_en: A square expressive oil painting depicts a modest bouquet of pale flowers in a round blue-green glass vase on a turquoise tabletop. The bouquet rises through the center-left: broad white and blush-pink petals spread outward, a more saturated lilac bloom crowns the arrangement, and dark green stems and leaves cluster at the mouth of the vase. To the right of the flowers, an ocher-orange irregular form sits on a darker surface behind the table, offering a compact warm counterweight. The vase is transparent only in suggestion. Thick blue, teal, and white strokes describe its rounded body, water, and the stems inside, while a dark curved line anchors its base. The tabletop sweeps around the vase in broad mint, sea-green, and pale blue arcs. A loose darker shadow extends to the right, made from broken navy and muted maroon marks. Behind the flowers, a soft pink wall meets a vertical band of cool blue-green at the right, producing a simple interior corner without detailed furniture. The image is unmistakably painted: short rectangular dabs, dragged thick strokes, and abrupt changes of color remain visible throughout. Petal edges are partly dissolved into their neighboring strokes, yet the bloom shapes stay readable. Light feels diffuse and generous, whitening the petals and making the vase glow turquoise, with very little sharply cast shadow. The composition is slightly off center and close, cropping the tabletop and upper background to emphasize color relationships. It feels intimate and freshly observed, energized by a balance of pale pinks, cool aquatic hues, dark green foliage, and one bright ocher accent.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现性油画描绘一束朴素的浅色花朵，插在青蓝色圆玻璃瓶中，瓶子置于绿松石色桌面。花束从中央偏左升起：宽阔白色和浅粉花瓣向外展开，一朵更饱和的淡紫色花冠位于上方，深绿花茎与叶片聚在瓶口。花束右侧，一个赭橙色不规则形体坐在桌后较暗表面上，成为紧凑的暖色对重。玻璃瓶的透明感仅以暗示呈现。厚实蓝、青绿与白色笔触描绘其圆润瓶身、水和内部花茎，一道深色曲线压住瓶底。桌面以宽阔薄荷绿、海绿和浅蓝弧线绕过花瓶。松散而较深的阴影向右延伸，由断续海军蓝与灰栗色笔痕构成。花后柔粉墙面与右侧一条冷蓝绿竖带相接，构成简洁室内角落，没有细绘家具。图像明显由画笔完成：短矩形点笔、拖行的厚笔痕与突然变化的颜色遍布画面。花瓣边缘部分融入相邻笔触，但花形仍可辨。光线漫射且充裕，花瓣被照白，花瓶发出青绿色光感，几乎没有硬投影。构图略偏中心且取景贴近，裁切桌面和上方背景以强调色彩关系。它亲密而像刚刚观察到的景物，由浅粉、清凉水色、深绿枝叶与一处明亮赭色重音的平衡激活。
style_prompt_en: Expressive oil painting leaves confident, broken brush marks visible instead of smoothing them into photographic finish. Broad strokes of mint, teal, blue, blush pink, cream, and violet overlap in lively patches; a small ocher-orange accent adds warmth and focus. Forms are built from color masses and directional marks, with selective dark green or navy strokes defining overlap and depth. Petal-like or translucent surfaces can remain partly open and ambiguous, while a few curved lines establish volume. Diffuse light keeps the palette bright without sharp highlights, and shadows are composed from colored marks rather than neutral black. Close cropping and a simple backdrop allow thick paint texture, abrupt color shifts, and rhythmic curves to carry the image. The result is intimate, spontaneous, and structurally clear despite its looseness.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性油画保留自信而断续的笔痕，不把它们磨成摄影般完成度。薄荷绿、青绿、蓝、浅粉、奶油色与紫罗兰的宽笔触互相遮叠成活跃色斑；一处小赭橙重音增添暖意与焦点。形体由色块和有方向的笔痕搭建，少量深绿或海军蓝笔画界定遮挡与深度。花瓣般或半透明表面可局部开放、保持含混，少数曲线则建立体积。漫射光让色盘明亮而没有尖锐高光，阴影由有色笔触而非中性黑色构成。贴近裁切与简洁底面让厚涂肌理、突然的色彩变化和有节奏的曲线承载图像。效果亲密、自发，尽管松动仍有清楚结构。
theme_en: Pale blossoms stand in a blue glass vase beside an ocher object
theme_zh: 浅色花朵插在蓝色玻璃瓶中，旁边摆着赭黄色物件
name: Maria Lassnig
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
